description.value:
Once on each of your turns, you can whirl into a storm of steel. When you take the Attack action, you may give up one of your normal attacks to instead swing at every creature within 5 feet of you, rolling a separate attack roll against each. If you're wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand, every hit scored this way deals damage equal to both weapons' damage dice combined, plus your relevant ability modifier and any other applicable modifiers.

You can call on this fury five times, gaining a sixth use at 17th level, and you recover all spent uses whenever you finish a short or long rest.
